title: RiverCity Rock Star Academy
venue_description:
RiverCity Rock Star Academy

Salem's premiere music education and live performance venue established in 2015 serving the Salem-Keizer area. Located in South Salem the academy functions as both a music school and performance venue. Features a professional Garage Stage with full backline equipment including drums amplifiers microphones and PA system for live performances. The venue is dedicated to enriching the vibrant musical community through education and live music experiences.

Music Programming

Hosts the acclaimed End of the Month Open Mic held last Friday of each month from 7-9 PM. The all-ages all-styles open mic welcomes solo artists duets and full bands performing acoustic or amplified music. All performance styles are welcome including music and spoken word. No registration required with sign-ups at the door starting at 6:30 PM on a first-come first-served basis.

Music Education

Provides private lessons and unique performance-based music classes for kids teens and adults catering to all skill levels in a supportive fun environment. Offers specialized programs including the RiverCity Ramblers blues ensembles for teens and adults exploring Chicago Texas and Delta blues styles. Spring preview shows and student performance opportunities showcase student progress throughout the year.

Instrument Sales & Services

Local musical instrument store offering new and used guitars drums keyboards gear and accessories. Provides instrument repairs school band rentals and rehearsal space rental. Exclusive local dealer for Epiphone Takamine ESP Sterling Music Man LTD Orange Amplifiers Line 6 Ampeg and DW PDP drums.

title: The Triangle Tavern (Triangle Inn)
venue_description:
The Triangle Tavern

Historic Salem dive bar over 60 years old recently remodeled with brand new stage and kitchen. Located on Liberty Road South the venue stands out as a vibrant hub of community engagement and entertainment in Salem Oregon. Known for its inviting atmosphere spacious outdoor area with cozy fire pit and engaging entertainment options.

Live Music Programming

Offers music seven days a week ranging from open mic jams to solo acoustic performances to full electric bands. Weekly open mic nights on Wednesdays provide opportunities for local musicians to perform. Has hosted notable regional and local artists including Pigeon John Ty Curtis Sandbox SXO Almost Friday Kalico The Cry Vicki Stephens Band Skunky Bunch 684 Bank Sinatra and Mr Plow.

Entertainment Features

DJ nights and engaging open mic sessions appeal to a wide audience. Features jukebox with classic and contemporary tunes ensuring lively ambiance. Multiple TVs for sports enthusiasts. Games including pool and shuffleboard. Large covered outdoor area with fire pit perfect for gatherings and events.

Food & Beverage

Offers a variety of bar fare at reasonable prices including popular beer-battered fries and nachos known for generous portions and great taste. Full bar with diverse drink selection. Relaxed environment complemented by friendly bartenders known for generous drink pours and welcoming service.

title: Taproot Lounge & Cafe
venue_description:
Taproot Lounge & Cafe

Established 2015 in a historic 1860s downtown Salem building with stage that frequently hosts live music and events. Located on State Street the 1800s historic building provides intimate venue space for performers. The cafe is known for chronically good times with philosophy of Eat Drink Thrive supporting local farms local businesses and providing outlet for musicians and artists to perform and display talents.

Music Programming

Friday and Saturday evenings feature live music showcasing some of the region's top musical talent. Intimate setting provides supportive environment for performers. Songkick listings show diverse range of genres hosted at the venue.

Food & Beverage

Main focus on juice bar featuring fresh vegetable and fruit juice selections. Full breakfast menu available. Light healthy meals tapas and desserts. Loose-leaf teas and full bar with crafty cocktails and craft beer selection. Open 7 days a week with breakfast service that transitions to lounge at night. Full bar for both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinkers.

Community Atmosphere

Serves vegans vegetarians carnivores and gluten-free diets specializing in house-made sauces veggie patties rice bowls and brussels sprouts. Known for hip but easygoing vibe attracting musicians music lovers and diverse patrons to downtown Salem.

title: Honky Tonk Bar & Grill
venue_description:
Honky Tonk Bar & Grill

Salem's largest bar specializing in country music live entertainment and dancing located on McGilchrist Street Southeast. The venue offers a vibrant high-energy atmosphere with a strong focus on live music programming.

Live Music & Entertainment

Features live music every weekend with consistent lineup of local and regional bands. One of the few venues in the Salem area offering good consistent live music. Themed events hosted on the last Friday of every month providing extra excitement and entertainment variety.

Food & Beverage

Southern cooking influenced menu focusing on hearty comfort food dishes. Features BBQ ribs slow-cooked and slathered in house-made barbecue sauce. Fried chicken served crispy golden-brown with creamy coleslaw. Burgers grilled to perfection topped with fresh ingredients. Mac and cheese creamy cheesy pasta baked until bubbly and golden. Tacos with seasoned meat fresh salsa and avocado. Vegetarian vegan and gluten-free options available.

Drink Selection

High-end whiskey selection emphasized in marketing. Diverse drink menu including local craft beers signature cocktails wine selections and regional cider options. Margaritas and sweet tea available.

Entertainment Activities

Line dancing lessons available for patrons. Karaoke nights featured regularly. Dance lessons offered. Multiple TVs for sports viewing. General dancing and entertainment-focused environment.

title: Venti's Cafe & Beer Vault
venue_description:
Venti's Cafe & Beer Vault

Salem institution since 1996 featuring street-level fast-casual dining with underground Beer Vault bar and event space. Located in downtown Salem at Court Street Northeast the venue blends community atmosphere inclusive dining options and quality beverage selection.

Music & Event Programming

Beer Vault serves as event space available for private parties. Occasional live music events feature in the underground venue. Full-service catering available in-house or off-site with custom food and drink suggestions for events.

Food & Beverage

Pioneer of plant-based proteins with vegan-first approach meaning plant-based options are default with optional meat upcharges. Clean hormone and antibiotic-free meats poultry is free-range and responsibly sourced. Signature items include plant-based protein bowls wraps burgers and globally inspired comfort food. All dishes prepared with fresh vibrant produce and thoughtfully selected ingredients.

Dining Experience

Open 7 days a week Monday-Wednesday and Sunday 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM Thursday 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM Friday-Saturday 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM. Dog-friendly outdoor patio seating available. Event space available for private parties with optional catering and beverage services. Inclusive dining focusing on vegan vegetarian and carnivore options.

Community Focus

Established as meeting place for gatherings hang-outs adventures stories games dates and great conversations. Staff known for professionalism knowledge and responsiveness to event planning needs.
